messages:
Nina (devex): quick PSA: noticed a cluster of errors from onboarding repos after the 0.4.0 publish. both Vercel edge functions and Cloudflare workers log 'No matching export' for imports like `@redwood/inference-sdk/edge` and TS intellisense shows no definitions. leaving notes & repro below.

Oleg (eng-runtime): that sounds like an exports/subpath edge case. can you paste the exact consumer import and the package.json that got published?

Nina (devex): consumers use `import { createClient } from '@redwood/inference-sdk/edge'` in Next/Edge and `wrangler` apps. Published package.json exports snippet I pulled from npm registry: 
```
"main": "dist/index.cjs.js",
"module": "dist/index.mjs",
"types": "dist/index.d.ts",
"exports": {
  "./package.json": "./package.json",
  "./node": "./dist/node.cjs.js",
  "./edge": "./dist/edge.mjs"
}
```
Errors from Cloudflare: `Error: No matching export in 'node_modules/@redwood/inference-sdk/package.json' for './edge'`. Vercel shows similar resolution failures. Some editors show TS error: `Could not find a declaration file for module '@redwood/inference-sdk/edge'`.

Priya (eng-platform): two likely issues: (1) missing wildcard fallback for older bundlers, and (2) types mapping for subpath. TS needs either a `./edge.d.ts` export or typesVersions mapping so `@redwood/inference-sdk/edge` resolves.

Oleg (eng-runtime): yep. Also subtle: conditional exports may require object form for import/require/default. For example: `"./edge": { "import": "./dist/edge.mjs", "require": "./dist/edge.cjs.js" }`. Some runtimes pick the first matching condition differently. Workers require exact subpath match.

Nina (devex): we also had a few customers who copy-paste `@redwood/inference-sdk/edge/index.mjs` which used to resolve with wildcard exports. switching to explicit map broke that pattern.

TypeScript-bot: automated note: when package.json uses subpath exports, ensure TypeScript consumers have a `typesVersions` or `exports` entry for the `*.d.ts` files, otherwise editors like tsc/tsserver won't find subpath typings.

Priya (eng-platform): suggested mitigation steps: (A) add root-level proxy files `edge.mjs` and `edge.cjs.js` that re-export the dist build so older loaders can find them without relying on exports map; (B) change exports to conditional objects for `import`/`require` and add a wildcard fallback; (C) publish `dist/edge.d.ts` and add a `typesVersions` mapping or `"./edge": "./dist/edge.d.ts"` in exports for editors.

Oleg (eng-runtime): long-term: add an npm-pack+resolve matrix to release CI that runs a tiny script in Node ESM, Bun, and a Cloudflare-like loader (wrangler or a lightweight vm) to import each subpath used by onboarding. That would catch this before publish.

Nina (devex): I'll open a small PR with the proxy files + exports change + typesFiles + a smoke test that runs in our sample-apps CI matrix. Draft patch I'm planning: 
```
"exports": {
  "./package.json": "./package.json",
  "./node": { "require": "./dist/node.cjs.js", "import": "./dist/node.mjs" },
  "./edge": { "import": "./dist/edge.mjs", "default": "./dist/edge.cjs.js" },
  "./*": "./dist/*.js"
},
"types": "dist/index.d.ts",
"typesVersions": { "*": { "edge": ["dist/edge.d.ts"] } }
```
plus `edge.mjs` -> `export * from './dist/edge.mjs'` and `edge.cjs.js` for require.

TypeScript-bot: also ensure `dist/edge.d.ts` exports the same symbols as the top-level `.d.ts` to avoid mismatched declarations.

Priya (eng-platform): add a release note and migration doc in onboarding to tell users prefer `@redwood/inference-sdk` top-level import when possible, and if they need edge-specific imports show the canonical subpath and mention versioned canaries.

Release-bot: build matrix: sample-apps/next-edge + sample-apps/wrangler + sample-apps/vercel-edge failed on sdk@0.4.0  import-resolution errors reported by CI.

Nina (devex): opened PR #1372 with the proxy files, exports + types update, and a small `npm pack` resolution test that runs Node ESM and a wrangler-like import check. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/1372

Oleg (eng-runtime): will add the npm-pack resolution step to the release workflow after this patch lands. Also add a couple of unit tests that run against a packed tarball so we exercise the real installed package layout.

Priya (eng-platform): good. assign follow-ups: add migration note (devex), add release CI check (eng-platform), add edge/ts typing test (eng-runtime).

Nina (devex): update: PR passed CI, published 0.4.1-canary and verified Next+Wrangler+Vercel edge samples. I've updated onboarding README and pinged a couple of users who reported errors. Monitoring for 48h. :thumbsup:

(reacts: :eyes: :shipit: )
